cues.zh: 今天我们来讲雷诺数。
cues.en: Today we're doing Reynolds number.

cues.zh: 著名的数，以雷诺命名，讲流体力学，和纳维-斯托克斯方程有关。——（布雷迪：但它不是单一的数，不像π那样？）
cues.en: Famous number, named after Reynolds, talks about fluid mechanics, to do with Navier-Stokes equations. - (Brady: But it's not one number, it's not like pi?)

cues.zh: 不是，不不不。这就像是超级英雄
cues.en: It's not, no no no. This is, this is like the superhero

cues.zh: 版的π。因为π是固定的。π只有一种超能力，比如圆之类的。而雷诺数，
cues.en: version of pi. Because pi is fixed. Pi has like one superpower, like circles and things. This is Reynolds number,

cues.zh: 这家伙能变形、能变，想变成什么值就变成什么值。但是，
cues.en: this guy can morph and change to be whatever value it wants to be. But,

cues.zh: 取决于它的大小，是很大还是很小的，流体会表现出不同的行为。
cues.en: depending on what sort of size it is, whether it's really big or really small, you get different behaviour with your fluid.

cues.zh: 所以它更像是一个你给特定情境贴的标签。
cues.en: So it's more like a label that you give to a particular situation.

cues.zh: 你让流体在某种设置中流动，这就像是高雷诺数，
cues.en: You have a fluid moving in some set up and that's like, high Reynolds number,

cues.zh: 它表现一种行为。但如果你让同样的流体
cues.en: it does one thing. But if you have the same fluid

cues.zh: 在稍微不同的设置中流动，现在它变成了低雷诺数，它就会表现得完全不同。
cues.en: moving in a slightly different setup where it's now got a low Reynolds number it does something completely different.

cues.zh: （Brady：就像从复仇者联盟里选你的超级英雄）——如果需要隐形，
cues.en: (Brady: Like choosing your superhero from the Avengers) - If it needs to be invisible,

cues.zh: 它就能隐形。如果需要逆转时间，它就能逆转时间。它想做什么都行。起点是纳维-斯托克斯方程。
cues.en: it can be invisible. If it needs to reverse time, it can reverse time. It can do whatever it wants. Starting point Navier-Stokes equations.

cues.zh: 所以这些方程用来建模
cues.en: So these guys model the

cues.zh: 地球上、实际上宇宙中每一种流体的运动、流动。所以我们有了这些方程，
cues.en: motion, the flow of every fluid on earth, in the universe in fact. So we have these equations,

cues.zh: 它们来自某种普遍的物理定律。我们有质量守恒，
cues.en: they come from sort of universal laws of physics. We have mass is conserved,

cues.zh: 我们有牛顿第二定律——由此得到我们的方程。所以我们先把这些写下来。
cues.en: we have Newton's second law - we get our equations. So we'll start by writing those guys down.

cues.zh: 我们之前讲过这些，也完整讲过各项的含义，但我们得到了上面那个，那个小的
cues.en: We talked about these guys before and we did the full sort of what everything means but we got the top one, the little

cues.zh: 式子，也就是质量守恒。然后我们有牛顿第二定律。
cues.en: guy, which is conservation of mass. And then we have Newton's second law.

cues.zh: 我对标准的 Navier-Stokes 方程又做了一点简化，我说这里没有体积力。通常
cues.en: I've made another slight simplification from the standard Navier-Stokes and I've said there are no body forces. Normally

cues.zh: 这里会有一个大大的加 F，我们假装没有——这就是简单情形。所以这就是我们的 Navier-Stokes 方程。
cues.en: there's a big plus F here, we're going to pretend there's not - that's the simple case. So here's our Navier-Stokes equations.

cues.zh: 现在我们要得到雷诺数。所以需要定义什么是雷诺数。我们用 e 来标记它，
cues.en: Now we want to get the Reynolds number. So we need to define what the Reynolds number is. We label it with our e,

cues.zh: 它等于密度 rho，乘以长度尺度 L，再乘以速度 u，
cues.en: and it's going to be our density rho, times a length scale L times a velocity u,

cues.zh: 除以
cues.en: divided by

cues.zh: 黏度 mu。——（Brady：Tom，我们为什么需要雷诺数？）
cues.en: viscosity mu. - (Brady: Tom why do we even need a Reynolds number?)

cues.zh: （这些 Navier-Stokes 方程）
cues.en: (These Navier-Stokes equations)

cues.zh: （你之前给我们解释过，它们是——用来弄清流体如何运作的可用工具，最初到底缺了什么？）
cues.en: (which you've explained to us before, it's - serviceable things for figuring out how fluids work, what was missing in the first place?)

cues.zh: 这里；方程一又简洁又简单，
cues.en: Here; so equation one is nice and simple,

cues.zh: 所以我们其实，那个家伙在雷诺数的讨论里不会变。但方程二，我们有三部分。
cues.en: so we actually, that guy doesn't change with the Reynolds number discussion. But equation two, we've got like three bits.

cues.zh: 我们换个颜色。这个家伙是
cues.en: So we've got - use a different colour. So we've got this guy is

cues.zh: 加速度，因为它是密度乘以速度的变化量。
cues.en: acceleration, because it's a density times a change in velocity.

cues.zh: 这个家伙是压力。然后这个家伙是黏度。
cues.en: This guy is a pressure. And then this guy is viscosity.

cues.zh: 所以黏度就像内部摩擦，流体的各层相互滑动并相互作用。
cues.en: So viscosity is like an internal friction, your layers of fluid sliding over one another and interacting.

cues.zh: 所以我们有三部分，关键在于，在不同的
cues.en: So we've got three bits and the point is, in different

cues.zh: 情况下，
cues.en: situations,

cues.zh: 其中某些部分会比其他部分更重要。实际例子是，如果
cues.en: some of these bits will be more important than others. Practical example is, if

cues.zh: 黏度很重要，当你开得快时，
cues.en: viscosity was important, when you go fast,

cues.zh: 你可以通过开得非常快来清洁你的车。——（Brady：空气会直接把它吹掉吗？）——正是。
cues.en: you could clean your car by driving really quickly. - (Brady: What the air would just blast off?) - Exactly.

cues.zh: 所以如果你车上有许多小泥点，
cues.en: So if you have loads of little bits of mud all over your car and

cues.zh: 你只要开得非常快，
cues.en: you just grow really fast

cues.zh: 空气实际上会把它冲掉，因为空气的摩擦会抓住污垢颗粒，帮你清洁车子。
cues.en: the air would actually wash it off, because the friction in the air would grab onto the dirt particles, clean your car for you.

cues.zh: 所以结果表明，如果你速度够快，黏度就不重要了，我们接下来会看到，这是因为雷诺数。在某些情况下
cues.en: So viscosity doesn't matter if you're going fast, it turns out, as we're going to see because of the Reynolds number. In some situations

cues.zh: 它们同等重要，
cues.en: they're all equally important,

cues.zh: 但在某些情况下，比如极端情形，
cues.en: but in certain situations, like the extreme cases,

cues.zh: 你会发现其中一个其实并不重要。或者其中一个太重要了，以至于压过了另外两个。然后
cues.en: you can get that one of them doesn't actually matter. Or one of them is so important that it dominates the other two. And

cues.zh: 你就得到一个更简洁的方程，我们就能解它了。因为众所周知，我们并不总能解出 Navier-Stokes。
cues.en: then you've got a nice simpler equation, which we can then solve. Because as we know, we can't always solve Navier-Stokes.

cues.zh: 所以如果我们能掌握这个雷诺数，就能简化方程，真正解出来，取得进展。
cues.en: So if we can get our hands on this Reynolds number, allows us to simplify them and actually solve them and get somewhere.

cues.zh: （Brady：所以雷诺数就是给不同因素分配不同权重的？）——正是，正是。
cues.en: (Brady: So the Reynolds number is what apportions different weightings to the different factors?) - Exactly, exactly.

cues.zh: 我们要么得到一个非常大的雷诺数，要么得到一个非常小的雷诺数。而我们在数学里
cues.en: We can either have a really big Reynolds number or a really small Reynolds number. And the sort of, the standard thing

cues.zh: 常做的标准做法，就是考虑它非常大或非常小。——（Brady：让我大概有个概念，）
cues.en: we do in maths is consider if it's really big or it's really small. - (Brady: And just so I've got some idea of)

cues.zh: （你说的是什么数量级，是几十亿还是负数之类的——告诉我们它在哪——）
cues.en: (what numbers you're talking about, are we talking like billions and negative numbers like - tell us where they - )

cues.zh: 雷诺数必须是正的，因为它是密度乘以长度乘以速度
cues.en: So the Reynolds number has to be positive, because it's it's a density times a length times a velocity

cues.zh: 再除以黏度。这些都是正的、可测量的物理量。把这些值代进去，你就会得到一个数，
cues.en: over a viscosity. These are all positive, physical things you can measure. And you plug those values in you'll get a number,

cues.zh: 它可以小到，差不多，可以一直降到接近零，所以，你知道，不能是零
cues.en: So it can be as small as, sort of, you can go right down towards zero so, you know can't be zero

cues.zh: 但可以略高于零。或者可以大到任意程度。
cues.en: but can be just above zero. Or it can go as big as you want.

cues.zh: 但一般来说我们说的是大约10到1000，
cues.en: But generally we're talking sort of 10 to 1000,

cues.zh: 大多数日常情况。如果超过一千，就是湍流了。
cues.en: most everyday situations. If it's over a thousand its turbulent.

cues.zh: 所以湍流就是流体相互撞击时那种混乱、疯狂的运动会。
cues.en: So turbulence is this chaotic, crazy motion of fluids crashing into each other.

cues.zh: 所以雷诺数有两种情况。我们有大的雷诺数，所以我们说它不只是大于1
cues.en: So we have two cases of the Reynolds number. We've got big Reynolds number, so we say it's not just greater than one

cues.zh: 而是远大于1，所以大约1000及以上就是湍流。然后你的方程，
cues.en: it's much greater than one, so sort of 1000 and above turbulence. And your equations,

cues.zh: 所以我们现在已经去掉了
cues.en: so we've got rid now of

cues.zh: 所有这些，像mu和rho这些家伙，它们现在——它们已经在雷诺数里了，
cues.en: all of the sort of, these guys like the mu and the rho they've sort of - they're in their Reynolds number now,

cues.zh: 所以它们不见了。
cues.en: so they're gone.

cues.zh: 所以这意味着你可以开始比较你的各项，最终得到
cues.en: And so what that means is you could start to compare your terms, and you end up with

cues.zh: 这个家伙：1除以雷诺数……
cues.en: this guy: 1 over Reynolds...

cues.zh: 这是平方。
cues.en: that's squared.

cues.zh: 所以如果把这个方程和原始方程对比，各项是一样的。我们仍然有加速度，
cues.en: So if we compare this one to our original equation, we have the same terms. We've still got acceleration,

cues.zh: 仍然有压力和粘度。但现在
cues.en: we've still got pressure and we've still got viscosity. But now

cues.zh: 我们算是去掉了所有其他漂浮的小项，现在可以进行比较了。因为引入
cues.en: we've sort of got rid of all the other little bits that were floating around and now we can compare everything. Because by introducing the

cues.zh: 雷诺数，我们做的是把系统无量纲化，也就是去掉单位。如果我说
cues.en: Reynolds number what we've done is we've non-dimensionalised the system, which means get rid of the units. If I say

cues.zh: 我有10个苹果和9个香蕉。那么如果考虑苹果，
cues.en: I have 10 apples and I have 9 bananas. Then if we consider apples,

cues.zh: 我的10个苹果比9个香蕉含有更多水果。但用我的9个香蕉
cues.en: I have more fruit with my 10 apples than I do with my 9 bananas. But with my 9 bananas

cues.zh: 我获得的钾比苹果多——单位很重要。这取决于情况，你不能说我的苹果比香蕉多。
cues.en: I have more potassium than I do with my apples - the units matter. It depends, you can't say I have more apples than bananas.

cues.zh: 这取决于我说的是水果还是钾。单位很重要。
cues.en: It depends whether I'm talking about fruit or potassium. The units are important.

cues.zh: 所以，通过引入雷诺数，我们做的是无量纲化，从而摆脱了单位。现在我们可以比较
cues.en: So now by introducing the Reynolds number what we've done is a non-dimensionalisation and we've got rid of units. So now we can compare

cues.zh: 加速度、压力和粘度。三种截然不同、单位各异的东西，
cues.en: acceleration, pressure and viscosity. Three very different things with different units,

cues.zh: 但现在它们都没有单位了。如果与加速度项相关的数值大于与压力相关的数值，
cues.en: but now they have no units. If the number associated with the acceleration term is bigger than the number associated with pressure,

cues.zh: 那就意味着加速度大于压力。比较它们是合理的，因为它们不再有单位。
cues.en: that means acceleration is bigger than pressure. It makes sense to compare them because they have no units anymore.

cues.zh: 这，这就是雷诺数的威力所在。——（Brady：那么雷诺数本身有单位吗？）
cues.en: This is, this is the power of the Reynolds number really. - (Brady: Does the Reynolds number itself have units then?)

cues.zh: 雷诺数没有单位。雷诺数只是一个数字，我们其实可以看出来。所以雷诺数本身是
cues.en: The Reynolds number does not have units. The Reynolds number is just a number and we can actually see that. So the Reynolds number itself is

cues.zh: 密度乘以长度乘以速度，
cues.en: density times length times speed,

cues.zh: 再除以粘度。
cues.en: divided by viscosity.

cues.zh: 先想想单位。 - （Brady：真是个大杂烩）
cues.en: So let's think about the units. - (Brady: That's a real hodgepodge of units)

cues.zh: 确实是。密度是千克每立方米，因为我们在三维空间里。
cues.en: It is. So density, that's going to be kilograms per metre cubed, 'cause we're in 3D.

cues.zh: 我们用方括号表示单位。
cues.en: So we use the square bracket notation to denote units.

cues.zh: 长度，就是米。
cues.en: For our length, well, that's just in metres.

cues.zh: 速度 u，是米每秒，然后是黏度，
cues.en: Our velocity, u, that's in metres per second and then our viscosity,

cues.zh: 这个可能不太常见，但它是千克每米每秒。
cues.en: so this one is possibly less well-known, but this guy is kilograms per metre per second.

cues.zh: 现在把它们都代入雷诺数公式，就得到 Re 的单位，
cues.en: And now if we plug them all together in the Reynolds number formula we get the Re, the units,

cues.zh: 上面是密度，所以是 kg m 的负三次方。
cues.en: so on the top, we've got a density so it's a kg m minus 3.

cues.zh: 然后长度，是 m。速度是 m s 的负一次方。再除以
cues.en: Then we've got a length, that's an m. Then we've got a speed (ms) minus one. And then we divide through by

cues.zh: 黏度。希望我们没算错。千克消掉了，
cues.en: viscosity. And now hopefully we've done this right. Kilograms cancel,

cues.zh: 米、米、米的负三次方给出米的负一次方，消掉了。秒的负一次方、秒的负一次方。
cues.en: Metres, metres, metres minus 3 gives us metres minus one, cancels. Seconds minus 1, seconds minus one.

cues.zh: 所以雷诺数没有单位。——（Brady：太棒了！）——所以它只是一个数字。这就是它被称为雷诺数的原因。确实如此，
cues.en: So the Reynolds number has no units. - (Brady: Brilliant!) - So it is just a number. That's why it's called Reynolds number. It does,

cues.zh: 它只是一个数字。正因如此，我们才能思考当它很大时会发生什么，并得出这个方程。
cues.en: it's just a number. It's why we can think about what happens when it's big and get this equation.

cues.zh: 现在雷诺数非常大，我们得到加速度等于压强；加上一个非常大的数的倒数
cues.en: So now the Reynolds number is really big, we've got acceleration equals pressure; plus 1 over a really big number

cues.zh: 乘以黏度。
cues.en: times viscosity.

cues.zh: 所以1除以一个非常大的数就非常小。
cues.en: So 1 divided by a really big number is really small.

cues.zh: 那这告诉我们什么呢，就是那一项无关紧要。
cues.en: So what's that telling us, is that that guy doesn't matter.

cues.zh: 所以在雷诺数非常大的情况下，
cues.en: So in the situation of really large Reynolds numbers,

cues.zh: 可能是非常非常轻的——非常非常高的密度。
cues.en: which could be very, very light - very, very high density.

cues.zh: 非常非常长的流体，或者非常非常快的流体。所以让——不管怎样，只要让这个东西变大就行。
cues.en: Very, very long fluids or very, very fast fluids. So make any - just make this thing big, however you have to.

cues.zh: 黏度无关紧要。所以当你开车，开得非常非常快时，
cues.en: Viscosity doesn't matter. So you're driving your car, you're going really really fast,

cues.zh: 这就是为什么空气的黏度不会清除你车上的污垢。因为你处于这个大雷诺数下，你的方程说
cues.en: that's why the viscosity of the air doesn't clean the dirt from your car. Because you're in this large Reynolds number and your equations say

cues.zh: 黏度无关紧要。所以它不，它不起作用。
cues.en: viscosity doesn't matter. So it doesn't, it doesn't work.

cues.zh: 那如果现在雷诺数非常非常小呢？
cues.en: So what if the Reynolds number is now really really small?

cues.zh: 我们说它远小于1。不只是小于1，而是远小于1。那么现在会发生什么
cues.en: We say it's much less than 1. It's not just smaller than 1, it's much less than 1. And so what happens now

cues.zh: 在我们的方程中，当我们代入这个，我们像之前一样进行无量纲化，但现在
cues.en: with our equations, is when we substitute this in we do our non-dimensionalisation in the same way as before, but now

cues.zh: 我们得到的是雷诺数乘以加速度
cues.en: we've got Reynolds number times acceleration

cues.zh: 等于压力项加上粘性项。
cues.en: equals the pressure term plus the viscosity term.

cues.zh: 所以现在这和我们之前的略有不同。
cues.en: So now it's slightly different to the one we had.

cues.zh: 所以我们有雷诺数，只是一个数，乘以加速度等于压力加上
cues.en: So we've got Reynolds number, just a number, times acceleration is pressure plus

cues.zh: 粘性。你可能想知道，为什么雷诺数现在在这里？
cues.en: viscosity. You might be wondering, why is the Reynolds number now here?

cues.zh: 为什么它在加速度上，而之前我们在粘性那边？
cues.en: Why is it on acceleration when before we had it over on viscosity?

cues.zh: 现在我们有一个小雷诺数。所以在小雷诺数流动中
cues.en: Now we have a small Reynolds number. And so in a small Reynolds number flow

cues.zh: 我们大概知道，我们做过实验，说压力项实际上是由
cues.en: we sort of know, we've done experiments, to say that the pressure term is actually balanced by

cues.zh: 粘性平衡的。
cues.en: viscosity.

cues.zh: 而在大雷诺数的情况下
cues.en: Whereas in the big Reynolds number case

cues.zh: 压力项由加速度平衡。所以在无量纲化的方式上
cues.en: the pressure term is balanced by the acceleration. So that there is some slight difference in how you

cues.zh: 会有一些细微差别，但原理仍然一样，它仍然具有压力的量纲
cues.en: non-dimensionalise, but it still works in the same way, it still has units of pressure

cues.zh: 你只是要在如何平衡压力之间做出选择。
cues.en: you just have this choice between how to balance your pressure.

cues.zh: 所以当雷诺数很小时，我们有这一项，
cues.en: So when the Reynolds number is small we have this guy,

cues.zh: 也就是雷诺数乘以加速度等于压力加黏性，但雷诺数非常非常小。
cues.en: so it's Reynolds times acceleration is pressure plus viscosity, but the Reynolds number was really, really small.

cues.zh: 所以现在我得到的是一个小数乘以加速度，
cues.en: So now I've got a tiny number times acceleration,

cues.zh: 所以加速度无关紧要，
cues.en: so acceleration doesn't matter,

cues.zh: 因为雷诺数非常小。所以这一项就消去了。这就是在小雷诺数 regime 下无关紧要的那一项。
cues.en: because Reynolds number's really small. So that now goes. So this is the term that doesn't matter in this small Reynolds number regime.

cues.zh: 所以现在只剩下压力和黏性，就这些。
cues.en: So now just we've got pressure and viscosity, and that's it.

cues.zh: 我们的控制方程就是压力梯度加黏性。我最喜欢的一点，
cues.en: Our governing equation is just pressure gradient plus viscosity. My favourite thing,

cues.zh: 我要说在整个流体力学中，就是得到这个结果。因为
cues.en: I'm gonna say in all of fluids, is getting this result. Because

cues.zh: 我们的方程里不再有时间了。
cues.en: we no longer have time in our equations.

cues.zh: 所以我们从纳维-斯托克斯方程出发，我们知道它是正确的，
cues.en: So we've started with Navier-Stokes which we know are true,

cues.zh: 质量守恒、牛顿第二定律，
cues.en: mass is conserved, Newton's second law,

cues.zh: 这是既定前提。然后我们考察了小雷诺数的情况，结果发现在那种情况下
cues.en: that's a given. Then we've looked at small Reynolds number and it turns out that in that situation

cues.zh: 时间从我们的方程中消失了。——（Brady：因为唯一引入时间的就是加速度项？）
cues.en: time vanishes from our equations. - (Brady: Because the only thing bringing time to the table was acceleration?)
